newsitem.title: GREECE: Euromerchant to buy C.Lyonnais Greek reta.
newsitem.headline: Euromerchant to buy C.Lyonnais Greek reta.

text.p: Greece's Euromerchant Bank and Credit Lyonnais Grece SA have agreed in principle for Euromerchant to buy the retail banking network of Credit Lyonnais in Greece, Euromerchant Bank said in a statement.
"Due diligence will commence shortly and further announcements will follow on completion of the due diligence process," it said.
The price of the deal was not disclosed.
The International Group Credit Lyonnais has been operating in Greece since 1977 through a representative office and its subsidiary, Credit Lyonnais Grece, since 1981, it added.

The Credit Lyonnais Group has a 96.4 percent stake in Credit Lyonnais Greece that will continue to develop its capital markets, corporate banking, shipping and treasury activities and international private banking for large clients of the group, it said.
Euromerchant Bank was established in 1990 and belongs to the European Financial Group, a banking group held by the Latsis family, it added.

Euromerchant acquired a 95 percent stake in private Interbank from Banque Worms and agreed to merge its operations with Interbank in 1996, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
